resourceAndConcurrencyResidualRisks: Native Darwin cannot enforce the 512 MiB RLIMIT_AS profile on this host; production fails closed there. The pinned Docker Linux runtime enforces it.
Temporary data is sampled every 50 ms: in-flight overage terminates the child but can overshoot before detection.
Declared footprints are not dynamically observed, and transient target-ref movement between rechecks can escape observation.
Only fixed patch preparation runs concurrently; candidate and serial tree integration are sequential. Concurrent merging and live-agent interleavings remain open M2 work.
The declared final-tree check validates a Git object ID only. Repository tests, external effects, failed project checks, and semantic correctness remain outside the authorized profile.
